rules.statement: In cases where a mistake is alleged in the deeds, all parties to the alleged mistake should be made parties to the cause for justice to be done.
rules.supporting_quote: For the purpose of regularizing the situation, the defendant is asking that the plaintiffs' deeds should be cancelled in so far as they purport to convey the 64-acre block. It is difficult to see how this can be done, unless both the parties to the deeds sought to be cancelled are before the Court.
